systems.tiers: launched 2026-07-31 at Agbandi, Blitta 2 commune; 6,461 children in this edition, 5,000 in the first, 11,461 across both; OIF gives nearly 7,400 schoolchildren in 25 communes; supplementary judgments and birth acts handed over

note: The ministry's own account of the same catch-up campaign: outreach by supplementary judgment. It mentions OIF support for 'digitalisation of services' without naming a system, and says many children, notably rural, remain without a birth act.
